simulation_physics.comment: Total momentum (not pT). Particle stops propagating below this. Units: GeV.

particleSelection._comment: Truth-particle filter applied AFTER digitization (addDigiParticleSelection). Particles failing these cuts are removed from particles_selected and therefore do NOT enter the efficiency denominator (and cannot be matched, so also not the numerator).

pt.comment: Minimum truth pT [GeV]. Particles below this are dropped from the eff denominator.

measurements._comment: Minimum number of digitized measurements per truth particle for it to enter the eff denominator. Counts measurements (post-digi), which equals truth hits when digi efficiency = 1. To allow the CKF leniency for missed hits, keep this >= trackFinding.selectorConfig.nMeasurementsMin (see comment there).

seeding.comment: Set truthEstimatedSeeded=true to use truth-estimated seeding.

deltaR.comment: Delta R range for finding seeds (4th pixel layer at ~174 mm)

selectorConfig._comment: Minimum number of measurements on the CKF track (post-fit). Tracks below this are dropped BEFORE truth-matching, so the corresponding particle is counted as not reconstructed.

navigation._comment: Per-layer cap on the navigator's sensitive-surface retarget retries. When the navigator's original navSurfaces candidate list is exhausted with NO sensitive hit on a sensor-bearing layer, it re-runs Layer::compatibleSurfaces from the (closer) current position. Resets per layer/volume switch. Same value applied to Fatras and CKF propagators. Set to 0 to disable.
